---
title: "A Typst theme for the window"
filters:
  - code-window
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
---

```{=typst}
#state("code-window-theme").update((
  border: rgb("#ff0000"),
  stroke-dash: "dashed",
))
```

The theme above stands in for a template, which sets the same state before
the body. The window below takes its border from the theme.

```{.python filename="a.py"}
x = 1
```
